data_objects.name: loan_score_records
data_objects.meaning: One row per keyed loan application record, with an application date, scene code, binary label, and four CRO score variants.

variables.name: rowkey
variables.meaning: Opaque application-record identifier stored as a hexadecimal-like string.

variables.name: apply_date
variables.meaning: Application calendar date encoded as an eight-digit YYYYMMDD value.

variables.name: scene_code
variables.meaning: Categorical scene identifier encoded as SCENE_ followed by a zero-padded number.

variables.name: label
variables.meaning: Binary 0/1 outcome indicator; the positive-class business definition is not supplied.

variables.name: cro_general
variables.meaning: Continuous score from the general CRO score variant.

variables.name: cro_general_reg
variables.meaning: Continuous score from the regression-labeled general CRO variant.

variables.name: cro_general_mle
variables.meaning: Continuous score from the MLE-labeled general CRO variant.

variables.name: cro_sceneid
variables.meaning: Continuous CRO score associated with a scene-specific variant.

structure.description: The table is flat and application-grained; rowkey identifies records, while scene_code groups records by application scene.

uncertainties: The file does not define the positive label or whether the continuous scores are calibrated probabilities.
The semantic differences among the CRO score variants are only indicated by their column names.
annotation_notes: Dates are stored as compact numeric-looking values and should be parsed explicitly rather than treated as elapsed quantities.
